en.title: AgentCraft
en.fail_showcase: -Showcase needs the sim backend (it holds a scripted state).
en.fail_reserved: port {port} is reserved for other dev servers; pick another
en.fail_repo: -Repo {path} is not a git repository root
en.fail_node_missing: Node.js 22+ is required (https://nodejs.org). `node` is not on PATH.
en.fail_java_missing: Java 25 is required (https://adoptium.net, Temurin 25). Could not run '{java} -version'.
en.fail_java_old: Java 25 is required for Minecraft 26.3 (found: {found}). Set JAVA_HOME to a JDK 25.
en.fail_locale: could not apply the Minecraft language default
en.reuse_other: not started by launch.ps1; stop.ps1 leaves it alone
en.warn_port: -Port {asked} ignored: profile '{profile}' is already served on {actual}
en.warn_backend: profile '{profile}' runs the {running} backend (asked for {asked}); stop it first to switch
en.warn_reset: -Reset ignored for a running Foreman (tools\stop.ps1 -Foreman first)
en.kv_skipped: -NoForeman: the game will look for a Foreman on port {port}
en.fail_port_busy: port {port} is already in use by {who}. Another Foreman (other profile/home)? Use -Port N.
en.warn_deps: not checking foreman/ dependencies: Foreman '{profile}' of this checkout is running on them
en.fail_foreman: the Foreman did not come up (see {log})
en.state_line: {active}/{agents} agents on shift, {tasks} tasks, {decisions} open decisions
en.fail_showcase_state: the Foreman did not reach the showcase state: {err}
en.warn_status: could not read the Foreman status: {err}
en.kv_game_running: already running: pid {pid}  DevBridge :{port}  (one client per checkout)
en.warn_game_port: it was launched against Foreman port {launched}, not {current}: tools\stop.ps1 -Game, then launch again
en.fail_stray: a Minecraft client of this checkout is already running ({who}) but was not started by launch.ps1. Quit it first (node tools/devcli.mjs quit).
en.fail_devport: DevBridge port {port} is already in use by {who} (another game?). Use -DevPort N.
en.kv_starting_game: gradlew runClient (pid {pid}; builds if needed)  DevBridge :{dev} -> Foreman :{fm}
en.kv_nowait: -NoWait: not waiting for the world (node tools\devcli.mjs wait --port {port})
en.fail_game_exit: gradlew runClient exited before the world was ready (build failure or crash).
en.fail_hung: the game is hung: {msg} (tools\stop.ps1 -Game, then relaunch)
en.fail_world: the world was not ready after {seconds} s (see {log})
en.stop_all: stop all      tools\stop.ps1            (game: quits + saves; Foreman: Ctrl+Break, state saved)
en.stop_game: stop game     tools\stop.ps1 -Game      (or just close the window; agents keep working)
en.tui_hint: terminal UI   cd foreman; npm run tui -- --port {port}
en.stop_none: nothing to stop (no run file from launch.ps1)
en.stop_stray: a game of this checkout is running but was not started by launch.ps1: {who} (left alone; node tools\devcli.mjs quit)
en.unix_usage:
AgentCraft launcher (macOS, Linux)
  node tools/unix.mjs launch [--backend sim|claude|codex] [--repo PATH] [--use-claude-login]
                            [--home PATH] [--profile NAME] [--port N] [--dev-port N]
                            [--locale ko|en] [--dev] [--showcase busy|late] [--reset]
                            [--no-game] [--no-foreman] [--no-wait]
                            [--summary-json PATH]
                            [--foreman-arg VALUE] (repeatable)
  node tools/unix.mjs stop [--game] [--foreman] [--profile NAME] [--stop-daemon]

Default: Korean UI, Claude backend, ~/.agentcraft, ports 7878/7879.
--locale en switches this launcher and the Foreman back to English.
Flags and commands stay in English. --dev mutes the game, keeps it from taking focus, and disables desktop notifications.
en.unix_ready: Ready. Stop with: node tools/unix.mjs stop --profile {profile}

ko.unix_usage:
AgentCraft 실행기 (macOS, Linux)
  node tools/unix.mjs launch [--backend sim|claude|codex] [--repo PATH] [--use-claude-login]
                            [--home PATH] [--profile NAME] [--port N] [--dev-port N]
                            [--locale ko|en] [--dev] [--showcase busy|late] [--reset]
                            [--no-game] [--no-foreman] [--no-wait]
                            [--summary-json PATH]
                            [--foreman-arg VALUE] (반복 가능)
  node tools/unix.mjs stop [--game] [--foreman] [--profile NAME] [--stop-daemon]

기본값: 한국어 UI, Claude 백엔드, ~/.agentcraft, 포트 7878/7879.
--locale en 이면 이 실행기와 포어맨이 영어로 돌아갑니다.
플래그와 명령은 영어입니다. --dev 는 음소거, 포커스를 가져가지 않음, 알림 끄기입니다.
